comparison.objective: Fit a rubber stopper onto a glass tube to a specified depth without unsafe loading.
comparison.physical_skill: Support fragile tubing close to the work point while twisting and advancing a tight stopper.
comparison.success_condition: Stopper at least 12 mm down and released; unsafe unsupported twisting, representing tube breakage, scores zero.
comparison.reason: This tests supported press-and-twist insertion on a fragile assembly. The candidate uses a hex tool and collar to tune a damper, then validates dynamic performance.
